## Summary

**PACK3216** (Pack 32 bit color to 16 bit color): Pack 32 Bit ARGB data into 16 Bit RGB565.

## Details

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Operation | `b & d convert → <vea>` |
| Syntax | `PACK3216 b,d,<vea>` |
| Short | Pack 32 Bit ARGB data into 16 Bit RGB565 |
| Description | Convert gfx mode. Compress 2 x 2 32 bit color into 4 16 bit color. |
| Condition codes | not affected |

### Encoding

| Word | Bits | Content |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 15–9 | `1111111` |
| 1 | 8 | A |
| 1 | 7 | B |
| 1 | 6 | D |
| 1 | 5–3 | Mode |
| 1 | 2–0 | Register |
| 2 | 15–12 | b |
| 2 | 11–8 | d |
| 2 | 7–0 | `00000111` |

- Not allowed &lt;vea&gt; : #imm

### Example

```asm
    pack3216    d0,d1,e2
```

```text
b d0: .. FF 00 00 .. 00 FF 00
d d1: .. FF 00 FF .. 00 00 FF
Result:
vea e2: F8 00 07 E0 F8 1F 00 1F
```

## Differences from AmigaOS / AROS / 68060

- The 68000–68060 have no PACK3216. It is new on the 68080.

## Do / Don't

- DON'T use an immediate `<vea>`.
